Title: Azure Container Apps is now eligible for Azure savings plan for compute

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps is now eligible for Azure savings plan for compute! All Azure Container Apps regions and plans are eligible to receive 15% savings (1 year) and 17% savings (3 years) compared to pay-as-you-go when you commit to an Azure savings plan. You can save by committing to spending a fixed hourly amount for 1 or 3 years, unlocking lower prices. 

Learn more about the announcement here.
